extDesc.message: Reformat any web page into a focused interactive Web App with an LLM. BYO key, client-side, open source.

status_need_bigmodel.message: Please configure your BigModel API key in Settings.

status_short_content.message: Page text is too short or unreadable.

ann_quote_missing.message: Quote not found in page text — skipped.

options_hint_bigmodel.message: Get one at $URL$. Uses the glm-4-plus model by default.

error_not_scriptable.message: This page type can't be read by extensions (chrome://, file://, Chrome Web Store, extension pages, etc.). Open a regular https:// page and try again.

error_network.message: Network error — check your internet connection, VPN, or firewall.

error_cors.message: Request blocked — if you're behind a proxy or VPN, try switching it off.

error_http_401.message: $CTX$ rejected the API key (HTTP 401). Check the key in Settings.

error_http_403.message: $CTX$ access denied (HTTP 403). Key may lack permission or quota is exhausted.

error_http_429.message: $CTX$ rate limit hit (HTTP 429). Wait a moment and retry.

error_llm_empty.message: BigModel returned an empty response — try again or change the style prompt.

error_llm_no_json.message: BigModel didn't return valid JSON — try again. If it keeps failing, make the custom style shorter.

error_llm_json_parse.message: BigModel output couldn't be parsed as JSON ($DETAIL$) — likely hit max_tokens. Try a simpler format or shorter article.

popup_format_help.message: Sent to the model as a steer. Leave blank to let the model pick the best shape on its own.

popup_format_preset.message: Aim for an information-dense dashboard: prefer visual and interactive forms (KPI tiles, charts, maps, comparison tables, timelines) over Card+Text lists. Surface 1–2 core insights and make key parameters interactive when relevant.

popup_format_placeholder.message: What kind of Web App do you want? Edit freely or clear to let the model decide.

status_reformat_done.message: Done. Showing the generated app on this page.

output_footer.message: Generated by Hypothesisor · L3 generative app layer

options_hint_endpoint.message: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Leave empty for BigModel default. Use this to point at DeepSeek, Moonshot, SiliconFlow, Ollama, etc.

status_reformat_done_tab.message: Done. Opened in a new tab.

status_reformat_truncated.message: Done. Output was truncated mid-stream — rendering partial app (try a simpler format if it looks broken).

jobs_subtitle_reformat_done.message: Web App ready · click to open

options_hint_language.message: What language(s) the LLM writes commentary in. Quotes always stay in the source article's language.

options_label_review.message: Run quality review on generated content

options_hint_review.message: Adds one extra cheap LLM call after generation to score the output and surface issues. Recommended.

options_hint_timeout.message: Maximum wall-clock time for a single Annotate / Reformat job. When exceeded, in-flight LLM calls are aborted. Range 30–3600. Default 180 (3 min).
